name: Azel
overview: The name Azel appears in the genealogical records of the tribe of Benjamin, specifically in 1 Chronicles 8:37-38 and 9:43-44, where he is identified as a descendant of Moza through Binea and Eleasah. Azel is noted as the father of six sons—Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan—highlighting his role in the continuation of the Benjamite lineage. These passages emphasize the importance of family heritage and God's providential preservation of His people through successive generations.
